_source: Transcribed BY HAND from the two printed Deepa Jewellers documents, never from extractor output: (a) the price band advertisement (4 pages; NSE ships it inside the 'ratios / basis for issue price' zip, filename RATIOS_BASIS_ISSUE_PRICE-121b6dd4.pdf) and (b) the Red Herring Prospectus dated 25 August 2026 (433 pages, RHP-37097bf3.pdf). Amounts are EXACTLY as printed: rupee figures in millions, share counts in absolute shares, percentages as plain numbers (accounting parentheses carried as negatives), dates ISO-8601. This file is the oracle for scraper/tests/unit/scripts/extract-filing.test.ts and MUST be edited only against the documents.

_documents.PRICE_BAND_AD: RATIOS_BASIS_ISSUE_PRICE-121b6dd4.pdf (NSE, 4 pages) — page text captured at scraper/tests/fixtures/extractor/deepa-price-band-ad-pages.json
_documents.RHP: RHP-37097bf3.pdf (433 pages, red herring prospectus dated 25 August 2026) — pages 0 (cover), 23–68 (SECTION II - RISK FACTORS, all 82 numbered items), 73 (Summary of Restated Statement of Profit and Loss), 104–105 (OBJECTS OF THE OFFER, 'Utilisation of Net Proceeds'), 119 (KPI table with EBITDA / net worth) and 255 (Annexure II restated P&L) captured at scraper/tests/fixtures/extractor/deepa-rhp-pages.json

PRICE_BAND_AD.business_description: Our Company processes and supplies 22K hallmarked gold jewellery, including plain and precious-stone studded ornaments, through an outsourced manufacturing model. We also undertake jewellery job-work and trade in silver ornaments, 18K/20K gold jewellery, precious stones, and gold bullion.

RHP._objects_source: Transcribed by hand from RHP page 104 (0-indexed; printed page 101), chapter 'SECTION IV – PARTICULARS OF THE OFFER / OBJECTS OF THE OFFER', table 'Utilisation of Net Proceeds' (in ₹ million). The same page prints 'Gross Proceeds of the Fresh Issue 2,500.00'. The general-corporate-purposes amount is printed as [●] — it is finalised only once the Offer Price is set — so the priced objects (2,150.00) are BELOW the fresh issue by design and an exact sum check is not verifiable at RHP stage.

objects_of_offer.label: Funding long-term working capital requirements towards procurement, maintenance and scaling up of inventory by our Company

RHP._risk_factors_source: Counted by hand from the RHP chapter 'SECTION II - RISK FACTORS', pages 23 to 68 (0-indexed; printed pages 20 to 65), ending immediately before 'SECTION III – INTRODUCTION' on page 69. Items are numbered 1 to 82 continuously across the INTERNAL RISK FACTORS (1–54) and EXTERNAL RISK FACTORS (55–82) sub-headings. Nested lists inside items 25 and 42, and wrapped line numbers ('192.', '213.'), are NOT risk factors and are excluded.
RHP.risk_factor_last_heading: The insolvency laws of India may differ from those of other jurisdictions with which investors are familiar.

_known_gaps.brlm_track_record: The advertisement prints two BRLM rows — 'Emkay Global Financial Services Limited 4 2' and 'Valmiki Leela Capital Private Limited Nil Nil'. The extractor reads only the numeric row; the 'Nil Nil' row is not machine-readable as a count, so the list holds one entry while the printed Total (4 / 2) is read separately and reconciles. Not asserted field-by-field here.
_known_gaps.concentration_kpis.southern_india: The advertisement also states revenue from Southern India of 94.37% / 98.33% / 99.55% (Fiscal 2026 / 2025 / 2024). Both printings of that sentence are split by the newspaper's two-column layout, which splices the neighbouring column's text ('(` per Equity Share) INR 168.00) INR 177.00)') into the middle of the sentence; the generic parser refuses the corrupted sentence rather than emit a garbled label. Recorded here so the value is not lost, and deliberately NOT asserted as extractor output.
_known_gaps.net_worth_by_fy_on_captured_pages: net_worth_by_fy is asserted only against the live full-PDF run: the net-worth row sits on an annexure page outside the pages captured in the fixture, so the captured-text run leaves that one field null with a failed check. Pre-existing, unchanged by this work.
